meta.title: Privacy notice | Intello
meta.description: What data this site collects, what we use it for and how we look after it.

header.title: Privacy
header.lede: What data we collect, what we use it for and how we look after it.

sections.heading: What data we collect
body: Only what you send us in the contact form: name, company, email address, phone (optional), topic and message.
The site uses no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking tools.

sections.heading: What we use it for
body: To answer your enquiry and, if you ask, to arrange a demo. We do not use it for anything else.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
body: We do not sell or hand over your data. Your message reaches our team by email through our email provider.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: The site does not store your message: it only sends it by email. We keep it in our team's mailbox for as long as needed to deal with your enquiry.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We use a single first-party cookie, itl_lang, which remembers the language you chose for one year. It holds no personal data.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data. Write to us from the contact page and we will reply.
